item.title: What game titles do you want to (or do) say out loud when reading or thinking of them?
item.author: invalid@example.com (Spring-Loaded)
item.dc:creator: Spring-Loaded
item.content:encoded: For some reason, whenever I see or think of " Pop'n Twinbee " I want to say it aloud, like I'm the title screen announcer for some Y2K Dreamcast arcade-style game, or some "Xtreme" drink-for-kids advert. A newer example is Metroid: Ravenous. I'll say the subtitle aloud under my breath in a real feral/breathy way, think about how appreciative I am they gave the game such a cool title, and just soak it in.
